courses.summary: 本課聚焦SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制。地圖提供公開研究或產業交流的背景；本課的模型和假設不宣稱在該處實測、發明或量產。
courses.summaryEn: This course focuses on SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits. The map provides public research/industry context; course models and assumptions are not claimed to have been measured, invented or manufactured there.

history.title: TI 名稱形成
history.text: 官方資料記錄公司源於 1930 年的 GSI，1951 年更名為 Texas Instruments；本課以其公開控制文件連結元件與機電系統。
history.textEn: Official records trace the company to GSI in 1930 and the Texas Instruments name in 1951; this course uses public control documentation to connect devices with electromechanical systems.

history.title: 積體電路成為控制技術基礎
history.text: TI 官方歷史記載 Jack Kilby 在 1958 年的積體電路工作。今天的即時馬達控制結合量測、計算和功率元件；地圖代表控制產業脈絡，不是本課所有設備產地。
history.textEn: TI’s history records Jack Kilby’s integrated-circuit work in 1958. Modern real-time motor control combines sensing, computation and power devices; this map indicates industry context, not the origin of all course equipment.

courses.connection: 從界定牽引工作區的課程問題出發，依來源追溯研究、元件供應與系統驗證的分工；代表地點不等於完整供應鏈。
courses.connectionEn: Start with bound traction operation and trace roles in research, components and system validation; the reference location does not represent the entire supply chain.

roles.role: 提供 SiC 牽引功率元件與模組，可對照切換暫態。
roles.roleEn: Supplies SiC traction power devices and modules, relevant to switching transients.
roles.business: 功率半導體（矽、SiC、GaN）、感測器與微控制器。
roles.businessEn: Power semiconductors (Si, SiC, GaN), sensors and microcontrollers.

roles.role: 量產車用 SiC MOSFET，可對照牽引效率。
roles.roleEn: Mass-produces automotive SiC MOSFETs, relevant to traction efficiency.
roles.business: SiC 功率元件、MEMS 感測器、車用 MCU（含嵌入式相變記憶體）與 SPAD 測距感測器。
roles.businessEn: SiC power devices, MEMS sensors, automotive MCUs (including embedded phase-change memory) and SPAD ranging sensors.

roles.role: 提供 SiC 牽引功率模組，可對照本課的電熱限制。
roles.roleEn: Offers SiC traction power modules, relevant to electrothermal limits here.
roles.business: SiC 與矽功率元件、電源管理及影像感測器。
roles.businessEn: SiC and silicon power devices, power management and image sensors.

courses.connection: 從「碳化矽牽引逆變器」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Silicon-carbide traction inverters. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
